editorial:
Ever wonder what happens when you decide to break up before you actually have a reason to? That is exactly where you find yourself with Mario and Olivia. They are head over heels for each other, but they have this weird idea that every relationship eventually fails. To beat the system, they decide to end things while they are still happy. It sounds crazy, but it sets up a funny and sweet vibe that keeps you guessing. The movie captures that messy feeling of early love and the panic that hits when you realize you might have made a huge mistake.

You will love how the chemistry between the leads feels real and awkward in the best way. The pacing is snappy, and the search for their lost cat, Miamor, adds a great layer of tension to the comedy. While some parts of the plot feel a bit slow, the emotional payoff is worth it. If you enjoy quirky romances, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After spending the movie fighting and searching for their cat, Mario and Olivia realize that their fear of breaking up was the only thing actually ruining their relationship. They finally stop overthinking and admit they still love each other. They manage to find their cat, Miamor, which symbolizes their love coming back. They decide to stay together and stop worrying about the future, ending the story on a happy and hopeful note.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird couples and cute animals.
